next.reason: 1985: 'VARYING ... BY {identifier-4 | literal-2} UNTIL condition-1 (BY required; UNTIL takes condition-1 only)'; 2023: '[ BY {identifier-4 | literal-2} ] ... UNTIL {condition-1 | EXIT}; "For any BY phrase that is omitted, the augment value is 1"'. The 2023 PERFORM format makes BY optional (augment value 1), adds UNTIL EXIT and adds an exception-checking format, so it accepts programs the 1985 format refused.
